title: Bearing Without a Fix
who: survey crew lead waiting on the corridor's edge
want: Fix the position of a repeating signal in the Fenrir corridor without going active.
at_stake: A guess sends the survey crew's tender to the wrong marker and costs a contract day.
complication: Passive overwatch finds a bearing but no fix. (complications.md, scout 2)

approaches.label: Park two probes and cross the bearings
Match the loop against old survey logs
approaches.npc_reaction: has logs older than the corridor chart

approaches.label: Ask the crew lead what the buoys skipped

Park two probes and cross the bearings.clean: the survey crew pays your crew for the fix
Park two probes and cross the bearings.cost: a probe drifts into an interference surge and your crew pays to replace it
Park two probes and cross the bearings.fail: the bearings never cross and your crew pays a day of the survey tender's time

Match the loop against old survey logs.clean: other crews cite your crew's log work at the calibration buoy
Match the loop against old survey logs.cost: the survey crew pays a small fee but files a complaint about the hours your crew took
Match the loop against old survey logs.fail: your crew pays for the copies of logs that do not match

Ask the crew lead what the buoys skipped.clean: the lead remembers your crew's patience and eases the tender's queue
Ask the crew lead what the buoys skipped.cost: your crew pays the lead's fee for the buoy list
Ask the crew lead what the buoys skipped.fail: your crew pays the lead for a list that proves wrong
